_doc: An auction settle records the completion of an auction. The winning bid is identified by bid_id. For time_based auctions, the settle MUST be inscribed after the auction's expiry block; for seller_can_accept_early auctions, it may be inscribed anytime after the winning bid. The settlement_txid refers to the on-chain transaction that transferred the inscription to the buyer and paid the seller.
_auction_id_note: The inscription ID of the auction op that created this auction.
_bid_id_note: The inscription ID of the winning bid inscription.
_price_note: The actual settled price (the winning bid amount): 7,500 DOGE in koinu. This is the bid amount the buyer committed to, which the seller accepted.
_settlement_txid_note: The on-chain transaction where inscription moved to buyer AND seller received final_price. Indexers must verify this transaction at 6+ block confirmation depth.
_royalty_paid_note: 5% of final_price (500 bps). Indexer verifies this output exists in settlement_txid.
_platform_fee_note: 2% marketplace fee (200 bps of final_price). Declared by the marketplace emitting this settle.
_auction_settle_rules: MUST reference a valid auction_id that is in auction_live or expired state
For mode=time_based: settle block height MUST be >= auction expiry block
For mode=seller_can_accept_early: settle may occur before expiry
For mode=no_early_accept: settle MUST NOT occur before expiry (INVALID if early)
winning bid_id MUST be the highest valid bid at time of expiry (for time_based)
settlement_txid MUST show inscription transferred to buyer address
settlement_txid MUST show seller received >= final_price in same tx
royalty_paid MUST match formula: floor(final_price * royalty_bps / 10000)
platform_fee is optional but if declared, output must exist in settlement_txid
6+ block confirmation depth required before indexer processes settle (MUST-030)
